context to investigate and fix issue: why does clanker requires me to sign into accs that I've already signed into previously? In the prev [thread](https://clanker-global.slack.com/archives/D0C6EAXPKEE/p1791494671575999), it had logged into my icloud acc to read my mails and when I asked it to read mails from Gouri, it asked me to login again. poor UX. \
\
Target conversation:\
\- Workspace: T0C6J1XCDE0\
\- Tanishq Palandurkar: U0C688SF7DZ\
\- Clanker: U0C5Z1ZQHQX\
\- Conversation: Tanishq’s DM with Clanker\
\
Use the existing configured Clanker bot credential securely,\
without printing it. Browser sessions do not select CLI identity.\
\
Verify auth.test returns:\
\- team_id: T0C6J1XCDE0\
\- user_id: U0C5Z1ZQHQX\
\
Resolve the DM channel from the thread link. Use conversations.info\
to confirm its participant is Tanishq, U0C688SF7DZ.\
\
Fetch the parent and every reply using conversations.replies,\
following pagination until complete.\
\
Keep Slack access read-only. Do not post, delete, or change permissions.
